description:
Bring the warmth of the French countryside into your nursery with the French Country Crib from Old Time Oak. Featuring a classic slat-style front and elegant turned spindles, this 4-in-1 convertible crib is the centerpiece your nursery deserves.
Handcrafted from solid wood with meticulous attention to detail, this crib showcases the timeless French Country aesthetic with its gently curved panels and heirloom-quality construction. The 4-in-1 design converts from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed, growing with your child from newborn through adolescence. Three adjustable mattress positions let you customize the height as your baby grows, keeping safety front of mind.
The slat-style front provides excellent visibility of your little one while maintaining the charming rustic look that defines French Country design. Available in a variety of finishes including Almond, Asbury Brown, Carbon, Earthtone, Ebony, Harvest, Manchester, Michaels Cherry, Natural, and Sandstone. All finishes are non-toxic and baby-safe, meeting or exceeding CPSC and ASTM safety standards. Coordinates with the full French Country collection of dressers, nightstands, and chests.
